data.text: Now I'll run a query to count payments by type, filtering out canceled and unavailable orders:

args.purpose: Count payments by payment_type for non-canceled/non-unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
  op.payment_type,
  COUNT(*) as payment_count
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY payment_count DESC
LIMIT 10
